evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in my second Cabloy Basic worktree. I need Vona, Zova Admin, and test:e2e:basic:clean to run alongside my primary checkout. Please configure the isolated environment.
evals.expected_output: Validates that the current checkout is a linked Cabloy Basic worktree before any write, inspects local precedence, and asks the user to provide one APP_NAME plus Vona, Zova development, and Zova HMR ports. It requires API_BASE_URL to target the selected Vona port, proposes only vona/env/.env.local and zova/env/.env.local, validates all selected listener ports are distinct, waits for final confirmation before writing, and separately asks whether to run npm run init after successful setup.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in a linked Cabloy Start worktree. I need Vona, Zova Web, and the managed clean E2E flow to run in isolation.
evals.expected_output: Detects __CABLOY_START__ and continues with the shared canonical workflow instead of rejecting Start. It proposes only vona/env/.env.local and zova/env/.env.local, selects npm run test:e2e:start:clean, requires distinct Zova development and HMR ports, does not reuse Basic clean-E2E names or flavor assumptions, and waits for final confirmation before writing.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment from the main Cabloy Basic checkout. Set up a second local runtime here so I can avoid the port already in use.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request without writing because the current checkout is the primary checkout rather than a linked worktree. It does not modify shared identity or ports merely to bypass a busy resource.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment for a linked Cabloy Basic worktree. Vona has an applicable .env.dev.local that already defines SERVER_LISTEN_PORT. Please put my requested port in .env.local and continue.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the applicable specific local override masks the broad setting and stops without writing. It does not edit, remove, create, or suggest reconciling .env.dev.local through this skill.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in a linked Cabloy Basic worktree. I only need ordinary backend tests and test:e2e:basic:clean; I am not starting Zova, mock build, or SSR preview.
evals.expected_output: Requests only a shared APP_NAME and SERVER_LISTEN_PORT, writes only vona/env/.env.local after final confirmation, and does not request or add Zova, mock, preview, or HMR settings. It explains that explicitly configured databases, custom Redis keys, and external providers need separate isolation decisions.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in a linked Cabloy Basic worktree and need to run both Zova Admin and Web development servers at the same time.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request before collecting values or proposing files. It explains that one worktree may run Admin or Web, not both, and directs the user to configure a separate linked worktree for the second flavor. It does not suggest a flavor-specific .env.XXX.local workaround.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in a linked Cabloy Start worktree. I need Vona, one selected Zova Admin development process, and SSR preview.
evals.expected_output: Uses only the two broad local targets, requires distinct DEV_SERVER_PORT and DEV_SERVER_HMR_PORT values for the selected Zova Admin development server, inspects the selected preview entrypoint, and requests MOCK_BUILD_PORT because current preview scripts also start dist-mock. It manages SSR_PROD_PORT only after confirming the selected entrypoint consumes it and requires final confirmation before writing.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment in a linked Cabloy Basic worktree, but zova/env/.env.local is tracked or not ignored.
evals.expected_output: Runs an independent git check-ignore -v -- target command for each proposed broad target and rejects the write before confirmation because every target must be ignored. It does not fall back to a specific local file or modify the tracked target.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment for Vona plus one Zova Admin process in a linked Cabloy Basic worktree. Another running worktree already listens on my selected DEV_SERVER_HMR_PORT, although its DEV_SERVER_PORT is different.
evals.expected_output: Reports the HMR listener collision and stops for the user to choose a different DEV_SERVER_HMR_PORT. It does not auto-allocate a replacement, omit HMR isolation, or propose a flavor-specific local file.

evals.prompt: I explicitly invoke /cabloy-worktree-environment for Vona plus one Zova Admin process in a linked Cabloy Basic worktree. Writing zova/env/.env.local fails after vona/env/.env.local was changed.
evals.expected_output: Snapshots the content and existence state of both broad targets before editing, restores every previously changed target to its exact prior content when any write fails, removes newly created target files, and reports the failure without leaving a partial configuration.
